cues.text: Heavy rain lashes a dark landscape. Wide waterfalls cascade over distant cliffs in pale yellow light.
High above, the bright streak of a colony ship descends through heavy storm clouds.
In the foreground, a large bird with a bright red crest sits on a mossy rock, watching the falls.
Lightning flashes over the endless deluge.

beats.note: A dark, rocky landscape under a stormy sky. Heavy rain falls. Massive waterfalls cascade over wide cliffs in the distance, illuminated by a pale yellow light breaking through the clouds. A large bird with a red crest sits on a rock in the foreground.
A bright streak of light, the colony ship, descends diagonally through the dark clouds above the falls.
The colony ship disappears into the clouds. Lightning flashes in the sky.
Lightning continues to flash over the roaring waterfalls and the rain-swept landscape.
